guard: Development old macro-AUC >= initial-.03; old/new pooled FPR <= recalibrated previous+.02; old/new pooled TPR >= recalibrated previous-.02; score gain>1e-4
limits: Constraints concern labelled known-attack development data, not heldout final performance
Mean-client AUC and pooled confusion rates can hide individual-device degradation
Previous deployment is recalibrated to CURRENT normal q95 before comparing weights; therefore threshold relaxation itself can lower TPR versus the original frozen old threshold
There is no absolute original frozen TPR floor in the present guard
Normal-only selector removes real attack metrics from online round selection only; it cannot guarantee attack retention
reporting: Report final old/new AUC, FPR, TPR and worst device/subtype. Do not call the guard a proof of no forgetting or guaranteed safe deployment.
